description: ATmega328P unless a profile names its mcu, -Os without LTO. Rounded headroom over the recorded baseline. Stack covers project call chains, excluding application/libc/interrupt frames. Figures include the unconditional secret wiping and argument checks, which cost at most 50 bytes of flash and 4 bytes of stack in these profiles. aes_ctr runs on the CBC/CTR/OFB core shared with DES, so it includes the block cipher descriptor call and the buffer and context overlap check. aes_kw measures KW and KWP at AES-128 with fixed keys and the constant-time S-box. Its stack is the deepest entry, TC_AES_KWP_unwrap. The fast S-box adds a 256-byte inverse table in flash, and the runtime S-box adds 512 bytes of static RAM. apdu_piv_read and piv_sm_cs2 measure on the ATmega2560 (256 KiB flash, 8 KiB RAM), the smallest common AVR part that holds a PIV reader. Their static RAM counts the link, the command scratch, a response buffer for a CHUID at its SP 800-73-5 Part 1 Table 8 capacity of 2881 bytes and, for piv_sm_cs2, the SM session, workspace and SM scratch. They exclude the transport callback. sm_framing_flash is the linked code of piv_sm_apdu.c and piv_sm_key_request.c.
